websiteBrief.name: Desert Shine
services: Regular Cleaning: Recurring upkeep so the house stays easy to live in: kitchen counters and appliances wiped down, bathrooms cleaned, floors vacuumed and mopped, surfaces dusted.
Deep Cleaning: A top-to-bottom reset for built-up dust and grime: baseboards, door frames, fixtures and the corners regular upkeep skips. A good first visit or seasonal refresh.
Move-Out Cleaning: Empty-home cleaning to get a property ready for handoff, whether you're moving out, moving in or preparing a home for the next owner.
